verdict.rationale: Airbyte's notification docs say it can send notifications about important events to a webhook, which covers the core of subscribing to events via webhooks ([airbyte-docs-9], [airbyte-docs-26], [airbyte-docs-34]). The evidence is thin beyond that and is framed around Airbyte Cloud. missing for 10: list of subscribable event types, webhook payload schema, programmatic (API-driven) webhook subscription management, confirmation for self-hosted/OSS deployments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
